Recovery · Bulgaria

Part-submerged drone towed to Varna from sea off Cape Galata, Bulgaria

26 August 2026 · Northeast of Cape Galata

Coastal aerial-drone recovery; individual origin unresolved

On 26 August 2026 a part-submerged aerial drone (UAV) was found in the sea 2.6 nautical miles northeast of Cape Galata, Bulgaria. Its engine and nose were under water, with the tail visible.

No explosive material was found. The drone was towed to Varna Naval Base and lifted out of the water.

No operator has been identified, and the release reporting it gave no final identification. Associations with Russian or Ukrainian drones made for the wider group of finds do not identify this one. When the drone came down and the route it flew are unknown. No casualties were reported.
